title: Farmers & Crafts Market of Las Cruces
address: N Main St, Las Cruces, NM 88001
description: Seven blocks of North Main Street packed with growers, bakers, makers and buskers. Go early for the green chile, stay late for the people-watching.

title: First Friday Ramble
address: N Main St, Las Cruces, NM 88001
description: Museums stay open late, galleries throw openings and Main Street turns into one big art walk. Start at the Museum of Art, end on Mesquite.

title: Live Jazz at the Winery
description: Local players, a glass of something red and the Organ Mountains turning pink at sunset. Bring a blanket.

title: NMSU Aggies Football
description: Crimson and white under the lights. Tailgate early in the lots on Wells Street.

title: Branigan Library Book Club
address: 200 E Picacho Ave, Las Cruces, NM 88001
description: Monthly book chat, all welcome. Copies are waiting at the front desk.

title: Taco Tuesday Trivia Night
description: Teams of up to six, $2 tacos and a host who takes the music round way too seriously.

title: Kids Craft Saturday
venue: Las Cruces Museum of Nature & Science
address: 411 N Main St, Las Cruces, NM 88001
description: Drop in, make something messy, leave the cleanup to them.
